epics.title: Project Setup & Infrastructure
epics.description: Initialize Next.js 14 project with Supabase, deploy pipeline, shared components, and offline sync engine as foundation layer.

epics.title: Registration & Authentication
epics.description: Player self-registration (3-step wizard), email/password login, auth middleware, and role-based access control.

epics.title: Player Dashboard
epics.description: Post-login hub showing tournament info, team members, round status, and quick-access leaderboard link.

epics.title: Active Round — Shot Tracking
epics.description: Core gameplay: GPS shot capture, club selection, shot outcomes (In-Play, OOB, Mulligan, Sunk), player rotation within foursome, and offline resilience.

epics.title: Hole & Round Completion
epics.description: Detect hole completion, calculate Best Ball via Edge Function, display hole summary, and navigate through 18-hole wraparound sequence.

epics.title: Leaderboard
epics.description: Real-time team leaderboard (authenticated + public shareable URL), sponsor logo banner, Supabase Realtime subscription.

epics.title: Admin — Tournament & Course Setup
epics.description: Admin layout with sidebar, tournament configuration, hole management (par, GPS pins), and club list management.

epics.title: Admin — Player & Team Management
epics.description: Player CRUD with team assignment, team creation with starting holes, search unassigned players, auto-assign starting holes.

epics.title: Admin — Scores & Sponsors
epics.description: Score override with audit trail, Best Ball recalculation, sponsor logo upload and ordering, CSV export.

epics.title: Security & 2FA
epics.description: Phone-based 2FA enrollment, SMS OTP verification, rate limiting, session hardening. Deferred post-tournament.

epics.title: Multi-Tournament Administration, Venues & Courses
epics.description: system_admin vs tournament_admin role hierarchy, global venue and course (incl. holes + tee boxes) management reusable across tournaments, and a Tournament Control Dashboard for operating the active tournament. Backfilled retroactively — shipped in #8, #18, and a role-hierarchy pass without a tracked EPIC.

epics.title: Admin UI Redesign
epics.description: Consistent AdminTopBar page-title header applied across every /admin page. Backfilled retroactively — shipped alongside the venues/courses admin work without a tracked EPIC.

lessons.title: `react-hooks/set-state-in-effect` flags indirect synchronous setState too
An offline write-queue that only supports `insert` is an architectural gap, not a missing feature
Stat-rotator-style components need test waits or panel-targeting, not `.first()` on shared text
A failing selector against an SSR card grid may mean "no data", not "wrong text"
Cost-log hook dirties the worktree; commit it BEFORE `gh pr merge`
E2E test fixtures rot when migrations change column shape
Next.js 16 forbids cookie writes from Server Components
Supabase CLI default flips silently lock the Data API
Admin page redesigns from `<table>` to cards silently break E2E role-based locators
GPS `start_lat/lng` records WHERE the player IS (before the shot), not where the ball lands
When intentionally widening score distribution, update test bounds immediately
Admin pages have a strict design system — always check DESIGN_STANDARDS.md
E2E test selectors must track UI text exactly — not spec intent
Admin UI: avoid static hardcoded status values that will never be true
PostgREST joins require a database FK constraint
Playwright `page.route()` cannot mock SSR Server Component fetches
Initial project setup
Playwright: use `xpath=..` for robust label→input traversal
Migrated DBs can drift from repo migration history
Tailwind arbitrary values: `duration-[400ms]` not `duration-400`
Radix Select: never use `value=""` on `<SelectItem>`
